an5.63:1.1: “Bhikkhus, growing in five ways, a male noble disciple grows by a noble growth, and he absorbs the essence and the best of this life.
an5.63:1.3: He grows in faith, virtuous behavior, learning, generosity, and wisdom.
an5.63:1.4: Growing in these five ways, a male noble disciple grows by a noble growth, and he absorbs the essence and the best of this life.”
an5.63:2.1: He who grows in faith and virtuous behavior,
an5.63:2.4: absorbs for himself the essence of this life.
